zh: 构建本地优先的 CLI / Python 工具，将公开微信和小红书链接转换为 context.json、context.md、SQLite 存储记录、图谱导出和 agent handoff bundles。
设计保守的提取边界：不绕过平台限制、不抓取评论/点赞、不泄露 cookie，并对不完整提取给出明确质量警告。
补齐端到端媒体处理管线：对图片和 GIF 运行 OCR、对视频运行 ASR，并通过 dry-run、回写校验、重新索引和回归测试控制结果质量。
en: Built a local-first CLI/Python library that converts public WeChat and Xiaohongshu links into context.json, context.md, SQLite store entries, graph exports, and agent handoff bundles.
Designed conservative extraction boundaries: no platform bypass, no comments/likes scraping, no cookie leakage, and explicit quality warnings for partial extraction.
Added an end-to-end media pipeline for image and GIF OCR and video ASR, with dry-run planning, verified write-back and re-indexing, and regression tests.

title.zh: Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro postmarketOS 移植
title.en: Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro postmarketOS Port

zh: 为 Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro（lmi，SM8250 / Snapdragon 865）整理 postmarketOS / Linux 移植项目，维护 downstream LineageOS 4.19 与 mainline/copydown 两条版本线。
完成 kernel、DTB 与完整镜像构建；在真实硬件上验证 downstream v27 持久化启动、rootfs 挂载、正常 userspace、SSH 与 Windows RNDIS USB networking。
推进硬件启用：D-v46 保持为已验证的 Wi-Fi 基线，最小 Weston GUI 下的屏幕与触控硬件路径已完成实机验证，并发布带校验和的复现归档；D-v52 仅作为后续构建候选记录，M-r7 仍未完成启动验证。
en: Maintained a postmarketOS / Linux port for Redmi K30 Pro / POCO F2 Pro (lmi, SM8250 / Snapdragon 865), tracking both downstream LineageOS 4.19 and mainline/copydown version lines.
Built kernel, DTBs, and full images; verified downstream v27 persistent boot, rootfs mounting, normal userspace, SSH, and Windows RNDIS USB networking on real hardware.

Advanced hardware enablement: D-v46 remains the verified Wi-Fi baseline, while screen and touch were physically verified under a minimal Weston GUI and a checksummed reproduction archive was published; D-v52 is recorded only as a later build candidate, and M-r7 remains unverified at boot.

title.zh: Markra - WYSIWYG Markdown 编辑器贡献

zh: 提交并关闭滚动位置丢失问题 #226，合并修复 PR #227，使 visual / source 编辑模式切换时保留滚动进度。
合并 PR #402，为表格加入列宽模式设置：默认等宽、可选择自动列宽，并保留文档级 toolbar 覆盖。
合并 PR #443 与 #501：修复设置窗口启动时的错误首帧，加入预热与复用，并在最后一个用户窗口关闭时安全关闭或取消创建辅助窗口。
en: Filed and closed scroll-loss issue #226, then merged PR #227 to preserve scroll progress when switching between visual and source editor modes.
Merged PR #402 to add table column width mode settings: even by default, auto as an opt-in mode, with document-level toolbar overrides preserved.
Merged PRs #443 and #501 to prevent incorrect first frames when opening Settings, prewarm and reuse its WebView, and close or cancel the auxiliary window when the last user-facing window exits.

title.zh: 小红书本地归档扩展二次封装

kind.zh: 开源项目改造与二次封装

zh: 基于他人的 Chrome extension 进行修改和二次封装，用于用户发起的小红书内容本地归档工作流。
扩展导出流程，将笔记文本、评论、图片和视频打包为本地 ZIP，并接入可选的本地 faster-whisper 转录服务。
强调本地处理、容错下载和用户有权使用内容的边界，避免将媒体上传到云端服务。
en: Adapted and repackaged an existing Chrome extension into a local archive workflow for user-initiated Xiaohongshu content.
Extended the export flow to package post text, comments, images, and videos into a local ZIP, with optional local faster-whisper transcription.
Focused on local processing, failure-tolerant downloads, and clear boundaries around content the user has permission to use.
